textField: *Flexion* and extension occur in the sagittal plane about a *transverse* axis. Abduction and adduction occur in the *coronal* plane. Turning the palm backward from the anatomical position is *pronation*.

overallFeedback.feedback: Flexion and extension occur in the sagittal plane about a transverse axis; abduction and adduction occur in the coronal plane about an anteroposterior axis; pronation turns the palm backward as the radius crosses over the ulna, and supination returns it forward.
